gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-gruppo: Marker-bold and unmistakably modern, Red Hat Display holds one steady line with daylight inside every curve, while Gruppo stays light. Its sans curves end far apart.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-gudea: Red Hat Display draws everything with a marker's constant line, so every curve lets daylight in. Gudea, a slim sans with glass-clear gaps at the stroke ends, keeps the text light beside it.

gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-hubot-sans: Stencil-cut and sharp, Red Hat Display holds one constant channel of weight. Hubot Sans, a plain sans with a widely opened e, then lets the text run lighter and easy.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-ibm-plex-sans-: Approachable is the first thing the body gives off, though Red Hat Display leads with bold, contemporary strokes and no calligraphic swell. IBM Plex Sans Arabic follows with easily readable open apertures, lighter and quieter beneath the heading.

IBM Plex Sans KR reads with openness at every curve end, light and modern on the page. Red Hat Display holds a neon-tube consistency above it.
